title: LA City General Fund postings, June 2026 vs June 2025

attempts.text: In June 2026, the City of Los Angeles General Fund saw a decrease of 5.3% compared to June 2025, with total postings amounting to $706.8 million, down from $746.1 million in the previous year. The largest movers in June 2026 were Fire, which increased by $36.1 million to $113.2 million, and Non-Departmental - Capital Finance Administration, which decreased by $25.3 million to $0.0 million from $25.3 million in June 2025.
